name: The Aether Valley
area: 204 x 204 meters (procedural blockout), expandable through streamed sector zones

districts.title: Foundry Square
districts.core: artisan guilds, festivals, commission boards and workshop apprenticeship
districts.production: a dense 19th-century handbuilt industrial fantasy town with layered stone, painted wood, copper, gearworks, plant life and shafts of warm light

districts.title: Copperleaf Circuit
districts.core: racing leagues, engineering garages, timed deliveries and trials
districts.production: scenic elevated hairpin course through orchard country, river viaducts, roaring windmills and modular spectator machinery

districts.title: Mosswood Forest
districts.core: ecology, forestry, environmental stewardship, bridge and dam works
districts.production: vertical fern forests with old-growth trees, mossy carved stone paths, hidden watermills, huge roots and delicate flying insects

districts.title: Crystal Deep
districts.core: cave exploring, surveying, geology, optics, excavation ethics
districts.production: multilevel basalt geodes, prismatic mineral growth, flooded galleries, rope lifts and abandoned research rigs

districts.title: Windward Reach
districts.core: wind farms, gliders, aviation, energy systems, outdoor survival
districts.production: cloud-washed plateaus with enormous turbines, linen canopies, weather stations, wind-carved cliffs and airborne harbors

districts.title: Clockwork Heights
districts.core: astronomy, precise mechanics, optics, clocks and space exploration
districts.production: mountain observatory with brass orrery, moving star-chart ceiling, lens towers, telescopes and moonlit observatory courtyards

note: The implementation provides terrain and scene-blockout landmarks. The ambitious descriptions are production targets, not existing assets.
